_keyword: US de minimis suspended 2026 postal shipment duty per parcel China

results.title: US de minimis ended 2026: a China sellers guide
results.snippet: Avoids per-parcel entry overhead of roughly $4 to $25 per package. As of mid-2026 a typical Chinese-made consumer good carries roughly a 35% combined rate.

results.title: De minimis 2026: why China small packages now cost 2x more
results.snippet: A $300 apparel parcel: import duties base 16% plus Section 301 at 7.5% becomes $70.50, merchandise processing fee $2.20, customs brokerage entry fee $35.00 per parcel, total landed cost $452.70 against $345.00, an increase of 31.2% per unit.

results.title: De minimis is dead: what ecommerce importers pay in 2026
results.snippet: Formal entry filing fee $30 to $80 per small-parcel shipment charged by a licensed customs broker. On a $50 item you can be looking at $20 to $50 in new per-package import costs. Section 122 surcharge: a 10% across-the-board tariff, currently in effect.
